dose_provenance: Directly read from Fig. 2A and confirmed against S1 Raw Images.

method.image_used_for_quantification: published Fig. 2A composite rendered locally from the paper
method.why_not_raw_supplement_only: S1 Raw Images clearly supplies all total-protein blots and labels, but the rightmost zero-dose sample is blank/unavailable in the raw-image layout; the published composite contains the complete eight-lane series.
method.intensity: integrated inverted grayscale within fixed lane and band regions; local background is the mean inverted grayscale of immediately adjacent vertical regions and was subtracted before phospho/total division.
method.normalization: background-corrected phospho / matched total, then divided by the 0 nM ratio.
method.below_background_policy: Negative background-corrected phosphoband intensity was recorded and the final normalized phosphosignal was set to zero; values are censored rather than interpreted as negative biology.
method.rounding: raw and background-corrected integrated values reported to 0.1 arbitrary inverse-gray units; normalized values to three significant figures.

limitations: One blot only; no biological replicate count or uncertainty was reported.
No source tabulation or spreadsheet of blot intensities was found.
The published composite is lower fidelity than a native acquisition and some phosphobands are near background.
pFGFR has non-monotone low-signal lanes after total-protein normalization; use it only as semi-quantitative supporting evidence.
pSTAT5 has near-background high-dose lanes. No model fitting was performed here.
fit_readiness: Sufficient for an explicitly semi-quantitative, constrained 2-hour signaling exercise using pERK (and cautiously pFGFR/pSTAT5), but not for a statistically weighted or definitive calibration without replicate/source numerical data.
